'''Anatoly Ivanovich Grigoriev''' ({{langx|ru|Анатолий Иванович Григорьев}}; 23 March 1943 – 11 February 2023) was a Soviet and Russian physiologist. He was a [[Doktor nauk|Doctor of Sciences]] (1980), Professor at the [[Lomonosov Moscow State University]], Honored Scientist of the Russian Federation (1996).<ref name="b">[http://www.imbp.ru/webpages/win1251/bio_r/grigoriev_r.html Institute of Biomedical Problems official site] (in Russian)</ref> Laureate of the 1989 [[USSR State Prize]] and winner of the 2001 [[State Prize of the Russian Federation]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://kremlin.ru/acts/bank/18374|title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 05.08.2002 г. № 831|work=Президент России|access-date=31 May 2018|language=ru}}</ref> Disciple of [[Oleg Gazenko]], Grigoriev was one of the leading scientists in [[bioastronautics]] and space flight medicine.

== Early life and education ==
Grigoriev was born in Medelivka, [[Reichskommissariat Ukraine]] on 23 March 1943.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-1839.ln-ru.dl-.pr-inf.uk-0|title=Григорьев А.И. - Общая информация|website=www.ras.ru|access-date=31 May 2018}} [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] official site (in Russian)</ref> In 1966, Grigoriev graduated from the [[Russian National Research Medical University]].<ref name="a" />

Grigoriev was a student of Academicians {{ill|V. V. Parin|ru|Парин, Василий Васильевич}} and [[Oleg Gazenko]].<ref name="b" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ras.ru/news/shownews.aspx?id=1c1ef77a-dbea-4f21-8e03-644b4eb165e1&print=1|title=В Институте медико-биологических проблем РАН избран новый директор|website=www.ras.ru|access-date=31 May 2018}}</ref>

In 1970, Grigoriev defended his [[Candidate of Sciences|Candidate]]'s Dissertation.<ref name="a" /> In 1980, he defended his doctoral dissertation.<ref name="a" />

== Career ==
In 1986, he received the title of Professor.<ref name="b" /> Grigoriev was elected a Corresponding Member of the [[USSR Academy of Medical Sciences]] in 1988.<ref name="a" /> He was elected a Member of the [[Russian Academy of Medical Sciences]] in 1993.<ref name="a" /> He was elected a Corresponding Member of the [[Academy of Sciences of the USSR]] in 1990.<ref name="a" /> Grigoriev was a doctor honoris causa of the [[University of Lyon]].

Grigoriev was also Editor-in-Chief of the ''Aviakosmicheskaya i Ekologicheskaya Meditsina'', and the author of more than 500 scientific papers. 

From 2007 to 2017, Grigoriev served as Vice-president of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. From 1988 to 2008 he was Director of the Institute of Biomedical Problems.

Grigoriev died on 11 February 2023, at the age of 79.<ref>{{cite news |title=Умер научный руководитель Института медико-биологических проблем РАН Григорьев |url=https://www.interfax.ru/russia/885840 |access-date=12 February 2023 |publisher=Interfax |date=12 February 2023}}</ref>
